info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: The Deposit Lending Adjustment API enables authorized users to modify specific deposit lending parameters for savings accounts identified by a unique parameter. This flexibility is critical for managing individual account features based on evolving customer needs. Financial institutions and lending partners typically consume this API to streamline account customizations, enhance lending practices, and improve customer satisfaction. Utilize this API to efficiently adjust deposit lending conditions tailored to specific savings accounts.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the deposit information for a specific savings account identified by its account number. You can modify various attributes of the savings account, ensuring your records are accurate and up-to-date.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the savings account details for the specified account. Ensure that all required fields are included and correctly formatted.

200.description: Request completed successfully. The savings account has been updated.
